descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-02 step 4 + ER · “Existing patients' data is untouched, and new patients are added with a Follow-up badge.”.

Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S13a Next server day: overlap scan after the day roll, each existing field checked against its retention window

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 When a day-2 scan overlaps day 1, the app shows 'N patients are already on your list' with an 'add only the new ones' option. … (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 5; TFA-92580 How it works 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U5 An overlapping scan leaves existing patients' data untouched. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U6 New patients get a Follow-up badge: scanned ones (including the new ones from a day-2 scan) and manually added ones. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 4; TFA-92580 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U11 'Day 2' and the Follow-up rule follow the server clock, not the device clock. A device set to the wrong date shows the same state (3.8). (UAT 3.8)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Local stack only (convex dev --local on 4510/4511, web on 6473), never dev or prod. Day-1 state from the previous server day, made with the aging helper. Hospital: QA Alder (on the day-2 photo) and the control QA Fig, room 404, who is on no photo. …

When On the next server day, scan h-day2-overlap.jpg and n-day2-overlap.jpg and settle the overlap

Then The overlap prompt appears. Each overlapped patient's chart equals its control's retention-adjusted state. The open task, the medication row and the vitals are still there (36 h windows), and in Nursing Home the chronic medications and open tasks persist. New Admission has turned to Follow-up on both, by the documented day rule (TC-04). …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Compare each overlapped patient with its control, field by field. Any difference the scan caused is a Fail. Anything a 3.6/3.7 window clears (Hospital pre-round text at 12 h) is not judged here, because it is retention, not the scan. The day roll by device clock is known: TFA-92584

Where it ran: local manual (time lane, a script does the person's steps); test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S13a is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json; a letter suffix = one case split in several), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane manual.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) (TIME (shift client-writable stamps through rounding:update/snf:update, manual/aging.ts pattern, then applyLifecycle)); secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: manual.

UAT item: TC-02 Patient List Capture · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-02/S13a

Next server day: overlap scan after the day roll, each existing field checked against its retention window

Tickets: TFA-92580 Patient List Capture (Scan Census OCR + manual add) (rejected by qa)

New local lane manual: status passed-partial in manual/results.json → passed (partly passed (every judged cell passed; part was not run / was mocked)).

How it is tested (manual/plan.json, automatable: partly): Playwright chromium spec. Seed QA Alder + control QA Fig (Hospital) and QA Juniper + control QA Yarrow (NH) with the day-1 state, every stamp ~20 h back (previous server day) and New Admission set yesterday (encTypeDay = yesterday). Open the list (page-load lifecycle runs = next day), scan with the census-scan action answered at the Convex socket by the h-day2-overlap / n-day2-overlap rows (trackActionRequests, as Tim's patient-list-capture spec does), settle the overlap (Same patient). Then compare overlapped vs control field by field on the server (tasks, medications, vitals, encType, room, diagnosis) and check new rows are Follow-up. The Hospital overlap cell requires the prompt to name QA Alder as already on the list; the NH cell requires QA Juniper's own row to carry '✓ In panel'. The UAT wording ('N patients are already on your list' + 'add only the new ones') is not judged (U4 gated, TFA-92580). — The overlap merge and the retention-adjusted state are deterministic and checkable. The photo read itself is mocked at the socket (reading accuracy is S11/S12's job); a real phone photo stays with S11/S12 on dev.

Detail:

12/12 judged cells pass, 2 recorded. Partial: the census photo read is answered at the Convex socket with the h-/n-day2-overlap rows (reading accuracy is S11/S12's job, on dev). Recorded: QA Alder's room / diagnosis after the day-2 photo (Q7) = {"room":"401","diagnosis":"Heart failure"} | QA Juniper's unit after the photo (Cedar 19) and the control leaving Today's Visits (Q6/Q7) = {"juniperUnit":"Cedar 10","yarrowInToday":false}.

During the run (runNote): 1 of 3 Hospital runs (14:5x): right after 'Add 5 Patients…' the page showed 'Loading…' and nothing was added (no prompt, no console error), while the local backend was overloaded ('Function execution timed out (maximum duration: 1s)', disk full); the reruns were clean. Not counted.

Evidence: 9 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — The given says local stack only, never dev or prod: the aging helper and the server-day roll need the local stack's admin key, which dev does not have.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
